prompts.name: RaceTerrain
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Raster sprite assets for an existing minimalist low resolution horse racing game. Image 1 is the ACTUAL ORIGINAL player horse, 26x18 source pixels enlarged 8x; respect its hand-placed pixel density, limited flat color clusters and side-view silhouette. Image 2 is the APPROVED game's farm background: match its muted sage/olive grass and warm tan path palette, simple sparse pixel shapes. Maintain that existing art direction. These images are references only, not edit targets. Make real visibly low-resolution pixel graphics with hard square steps, small palette, flat main colors, at most one shadow and one highlight per material. No thick outlines, no smooth vector curves, no microtexture, no painterly brushwork, no glossy 3D, no cinematic lighting, no noise, no anti-aliasing, no soft gradients, no labels, no lettering, no watermarks, no horses or characters. Orthographic side/slightly-overhead racecourse view, horses run left to right. Native source pixels should enlarge as visibly square blocks. Restrained golden tan timber, cream accents, dark warm brown, muted olive foliage, sandy warm earth. Create ONE 4:1 horizontal terrain atlas with exactly 4 adjacent square cells, no margins, no gaps, no visible grid dividers. Logical source canvas ONLY 256x64 pixels (four 64x64 source-pixel tiles) enlarged with nearest neighbor. Cell 1: full square of flat muted tan packed-earth racing track, base #B28A59, just five tiny 1-2 pixel ochre marks near center, edges completely quiet. Cell 2: same soil base and identical flat edge color but slightly different sparse central hoof marks, no actual footprints or lane marks. Cell 3: full square flat sage grass #7E8F51, three small 2-pixel grass clusters near center only. Cell 4: same flat green base with four sparse clusters, all edge colors identical to cell 3. No directional lighting, no vignette, no gradients. No objects, grass borders, trees, stones, scenery, track lines or fences. Every cell is a pure ground material without perspective or cast shadows. These textures must stay visually calm under the small horse and repeated lane markings. Full opaque canvas.

True transparent alpha, no baked checkerboard, no drop shadows, no terrain patches under props.
